findings.title: Installed community cards used letter-only identity markers instead of recognizable community identity.
findings.rootCause: The local-demo list used first-letter CircleAvatar content even when extension identity and accent color were available.
findings.remediation: Replaced letter avatars with keyed domain icons and accent color in both community list cards and opened-community hero state.
findings.retest: A6 card-image test and wf_b25-local-shell-production-polish-gates assert identity icon keys and no bare letter marker.

findings.title: Debug banner was visible in evidence screenshots and below production-grade shell quality.
findings.rootCause: MaterialApp kept the default debug banner enabled.
findings.remediation: Set debugShowCheckedModeBanner to false and added a widget test assertion.

findings.title: Form fallback copy read like generic review machinery on workflows without a specialized category.
findings.rootCause: Form-category workflows fell through to generic community-detail summary and chip labels.
findings.remediation: Added Form-category summaries and metadata chips with member-form, privacy, and review-handoff language.
findings.retest: Refreshed workflow evidence screenshots and production UX contract tests pass.
